version: 0.4.0
kind: editor-manifest
schema_type: manifest

  naming:
    file_suffix: .editor.manifest.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:

    path: udi
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: id
    path: id
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: panes
    path: panes

    required: false

      type: object

  - name: commands
    path: commands
    type: array
    required: false
    item:
      type: object

  id: ""
  panes: []
